notes:
v2.7.1 is a small update for tablets.

Full Dogbox on a tablet: installing Dogbox from the dashboard on a tablet used to give you a second POS icon. It now installs as Dogbox, with its own icon, so a tablet can have POS, Full Dogbox, or both, each opening without the address bar. The POS icon is now the Dogbox dog with "POS" under it.

Full screen on the sign-in page and the dashboard: on a tablet or another device on your network, a Full screen button hides the browser's bars. Signing in or reloading the page ends full screen (a browser rule), so a "Tap anywhere to return to full screen" note shows, and the next tap brings it back. POS shows the same note.

Usage count: once a day, when Dogbox checks for updates, it also sends a random install number, the version, your operating system and the kind of licence (unregistered, trial, paid), so we can count how many people use it. Nothing about you or your business is sent. See the privacy policy on our website.
